scope: Corollary 3.6 (Counts in an enclosing box) of the manuscript “The joint scaling limit of critical Ashkin-Teller currents” (preprints/The-joint-scaling-limit-of-critical-Ashkin-Teller-currents-October-6-2026/main.pdf), one of the manuscripts of result family 233 of openai/math at commit 1581d4cbdd69. The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 cec129cca8c2a0a6), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF pages 24-25. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. The quote crosses a page break and includes whatever the extraction places there, such as a page number. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. AMVO has checked nothing about this claim.
statement: Fix a bounded box L and b > 0. Suppose the finite lattice domain and the supports under consideration lie in L, and place L in a fixed larger regular ambient box. For one free flat N law, or the residual product law with a common fill conditional on its initial exact cut data, let Nδ(b) = #{ free N clusters C : diam C ≥ b }. There are constants C, c > 0, depending on L, b, t but not on the initial walls or the mesh, such that P[Nδ(b) ≥ n | initial cut data] ≤ Ce−cn . (3.14) The unconditioned free dual current is included. For the original wired current, expose its boundary cluster first; its free descendants satisfy this estimate conditionally, and adding the distinguished boundary cluster increases the count by at most one. The boxes and all cover buffers are fixed before the mesh limit. There is also a pathwise consequence for a seed exploration. Suppose a compact set Q is at distance at least r > 0 from the seed and initial removed support. List the discovered free clusters 24 whose support meets Q, or whose union of odd holes meets Q. If Lδ(τ; Q, r) is the number listed up to any stop, then, for all sufficiently small δ, Lδ(τ; Q, r) ≤ Nδ,initial(r/3). (3.15) Add one on the right if the distinguished wired cluster is listed. This is domination by the initial count, not a tail conditional on the completed stop.
